Rams defeat Giants in blowout; Jaxson Dart suffers knee injury

The Los Angeles Rams secured a decisive victory over the New York Giants. Rams quarterback Matthew Stafford threw four touchdown passes in the game. The Giants' season, which had begun with excitement, was overshadowed by a knee injury sustained by Jaxson Dart. Aaron Donald, who had come out of retirement, participated in the Rams' win.
